## About
Musher Auto Body is a family owned and operated shop on S Cicero Ave, serving Cicero and the Near West Side. We know a wreck is upsetting, so we keep things simple: up front pricing, and technicians who explain the repair process to your satisfaction.
We do most types of auto body work, including dent repair, fenders, and unibody repair, plus expert paint matching. Customers know the owner, Alberto, by name, and we offer service in English and Spanish.
We're rated 4.9 from 90 Google reviews, and a lot of our work comes from friends and family sending each other our way.

## Services
- Major Collision Repair: Serious accident damage repaired, with a fair quote and a reasonable estimate of time.
- Minor Accident Touch Up: Small accident damage fixed so your car looks right again.
- Dent Repair: Dents of all kinds, from door dings to bigger damage.
- Paint Matching: Expert paint matching so new paint blends with the rest of your car.
- Frame and Unibody Repair: Structural repair for frame and unibody damage after a collision.
- Suspension details: Suspension work done as part of getting your car back to how it should be.
- Scratches removed: One customer had scratches removed and said it was done at an affordable price.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How fast will I hear back about a quote?
A: Send your details and questions through the form on our site, and please allow 24 to 48 hours for a reply.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: One customer said we worked well with her insurance company after her accidents.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Cicero and serve the Near West Side, including Berwyn, Oak Park, Forest Park, Riverside, La Grange, Stickney and nearby towns.
